notes: null = UNPROVEN. Fill each stage with {"result": "PASS|FAIL|BLOCKED", "log": "path/to/sanitized/evidence.log", "date": "ISO-8601"}. The log file must exist in the repository (sanitized: no license material, no customer content, no private paths). scripts/check_cat_matrix.py fails on any filled stage whose log is missing, and forbids changing top-level status away from UNPROVEN until EVERY stage of every application is documented. See docs/CAT_COMPATIBILITY.md for the evidence policy and docs/SECURITY_REMEDIATION_STATUS.md section 4.
